text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Alert: sudden rise in 5xx/timeouts for /v1/generate in us-west-2 after recent prod cutover (deploy id c3f2a). p95 -> 800ms, p99 -> 1.6s. Error rate ~6% and climbing.

Alice Nguyen: I'm the current on-call, taking this. paging @Ben Ortiz for infra help.

Ben Ortiz: on it. pulling traces and gateway logs now. confirmed spike at 15:02:30Z which matches deploy window. any canary flag?

Alice Nguyen: Canaries looked fine earlier. Looks like rollout finished across region around 15:02:05Z.

Carla Singh: seeing a lot of `GRPC deadline_exceeded` and `upstream_reset` in gateway logs from router-3/4. sample: ```2026-03-17T15:03:12Z router-3 | POST /v1/generate 504 upstream_timeout seq=... deadline_exceeded```

Ben Ortiz: tracing the request path — KV cache warmup seems slow; many requests hit cold KV path and stall. Also queueing at the inference frontends.

Maya Patel: support dashboard: customer-facing errors spike correlates, ~4% of requests fail for some tenants (ACME, Zephyr). No PII exposed, but UX impact > pages threshold.

Alice Nguyen: immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic to previous model variant (model-v1) 2) scale up warm pool 3) consider rollback if divert doesn't help. Ben, can you set route weights?

Ben Ortiz: running: `redwoodctl routes set-weight --region us-west-2 model-v2=0.0 model-v1=1.0 --reason "postdeploy timeout regression"`

ops-bot: Command accepted: routes update in progress.

Ben Ortiz: also kicked off `redwoodctl pool scale --pool inference-warm-usw2 --replicas 8` to increase warm instances.

Carla Singh: after weight shift, initial metrics: p95 dropped from 800ms -> 240ms within 40s, error rate down to ~1.2%. watching for stabilization.

Ryan Cho: enabling fallback route for long-running requests: `gateway.cfg.timeout=6s -> 10s` for region as temporary. note: increases tail cost but reduces client errors.

Alice Nguyen: good. keep that for now. Ben, estimate rollback ETA if needed.

Ben Ortiz: if divert doesn't hold, manual rollback of inference-api deployment to `v1` tag will take ~60s to start, full health ~2m. I can trigger.

Maya Patel: notifying frontline: posting summary to #support and sending a short customer advisory to affected tenants: "Transient timeouts after recent deploy; mitigation in progress; we will update."

Carla Singh: telemetry looks stable for 3m now: p99 at ~260ms, errors ~0.9%. No new 5xx alerts.

Alice Nguyen: holding. will not rollback for now. create incident ticket. Ben, please collect traces and key logs for postmortem.

Ben Ortiz: copied trace ids and exported: `trace: usw2:c3f2a:01..` saved to /var/incident/3259876543/traces.tar.gz

Ryan Cho: rollback prepped but not executed. leaving fallback timeout change in place until tomorrow 06:00 UTC or until postmortem.

Carla Singh: quick note — root cause likely timing-sensitive: combined effect of KV warmup pace + small change in kernel scheduling from v2. We'll confirm in postmortem.

Alice Nguyen: summarizing: impact limited to ~4% of requests immediately after cutover, mitigation (route weight + warm pool + timeout tweak) restored SLOs within ~2m, no data loss. Incident owner: Alice Nguyen. Runbook tasking: Ben to collect artifacts, Carla + Ryan to reproduce warmup locally, Maya to coordinate customer comms.

Maya Patel: posted customer advisory and updated #support. customers informed: ACME, Zephyr, Nimbus.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Rollback not performed.

Ben Ortiz: opening follow-up ticket: INF-2026-402 for deploy safety improvements and automated canary gating on KV warmup signals.

Alice Nguyen: thanks all. handing off long-lived follow-ups to oncall rotation. good work. :thumbsup:

Carla Singh: will keep monitoring the dashboards for the next 2 hours and update if anything regresses.

Ben Ortiz: last check at 15:13:40Z: p99 230ms, errors 0.6%. closing active paging.

Alice Nguyen: closing thread and will draft postmortem.
